The pie chart and the bar chart above present the findings of a survey on consumer acceptance of elderly-care robots and people's foremost concerns. As is shown in the pie chart, 39.3% of the respondents fully accept such robots, 32.8% partially accept them, and the remaining 27.9% refuse to accept them.Meanwhile, the bar chart indicates that safety ranks first at 46.30%, far ahead of price, which accounts for 24.90%, and convenience, which makes up only 10.70%.

Several factors account for these figures. As society ages rapidly and the demand for elderly care keeps
rising, robots are increasingly viewed as a practical solution, which explains why over 70% of peopleaccept them to some degree. However, since these machines serve vulnerable elderly users, the public naturally worries most about whether they are safe and reliable rather than cheap or convenient.

In my view, elderly-care robots represent a promising trend that deserves encouragement. To win wideracceptance, manufacturers should place safety at the core of their design while gradually bringingdown prices. Only when these concerns are properly addressed can such technology truly benefit the
aging population.

Dear Paul, 
Thank you for your kind message and your warm interest in our craft demonstration.

You asked what the young craftsmen will show. They will present innovative works such as paper-cutting reshaped into modern greeting cards, and pottery decorated with bold digital-style patterns,blending old traditions with fresh creative ideas.

As for your help, I would be truly grateful if you could design a few eye-catching posters to promote the event, and greet our guests at the entrance on that day. Your talent and energy would make everything run more smoothly.

Looking forward to working together with you. 

Yours, Li Ming

**Dear Paul,**

I'm thrilled to hear from you. Regarding your upcoming oral report, I'd be delighted to offer some constructive advice.

First, I suggest selecting a prominent figure with well-documented achievements, such as Zhang Heng. This ensures you have ample resources. Second, structure your presentation logically. Briefly introduce his historical background, highlight his paramount contributions, and conclude with his lasting legacy. Furthermore, incorporating visual aids like slides or physical models will immensely enhance audience engagement. Finally, rehearse your speech several times to boost your fluency and confidence.

**Should you need any further assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out. I wish you the best of luck!**

**Yours,**
**Li Ming**
